summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py with 42 passing tests together with test/test_path.py. The full test/test_extras suite passes (100 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed). Nothing is committed. mypy, black, isort and ruff are not installed in the shared venv, so type checking and formatting were verified only by reading, not by running the tools. Two new untracked files; no other files changed.
